statement_summary: Security Coordinator and OT lead designated in writing
Annual risk analysis with SP 800-30 and SP 800-82 threat sources
Risk acceptance authority; no High acceptance of safety or environmental risk
Sanctions recorded; good-faith reporting protected
No security terms, no vendor access or Restricted data; vendor checklist
Annual independent evaluation
Five-year retention of security records
Annual policy review; policies available to staff
Written, risk-rated, time-limited exceptions
Unique accounts; HMI shared login only with compensating controls
Role-based least privilege approved before access
MFA on SaaS, mobile viewer, backup console, admin, and remote access
Vendor sessions only through the session tool, enabled per session and logged
Last-day checklist including shared passwords and gate code
Quarterly account review
10-minute lock; HMI exempt only while the field office is locked
Sealed emergency administrator credentials
Password length; default passwords changed before connection
IT/OT firewall; nothing on SCADA reachable from the internet; no cloud commands to controllers
Physical access; quarterly gate code change
Need-to-know use of company systems and data
No Restricted data in personal accounts or public AI tools
No personal devices, USB drives, or visiting laptops on the SCADA host
Lock screens; never share passwords or MFA codes
Training at hire and yearly with a field module; phishing exercises
Report suspected incidents and unexplained HMI behavior at once
Signed policy acknowledgment
Ransomware-to-SCADA runbook linked to the emergency response plan; printed copies
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Log every incident
Authority to isolate SCADA; never bypass safety shutdowns
Preserve evidence when it does not delay safety
Insurer hotline first; MSP and integrator engaged
Meet notification deadlines; counsel reviews; no-harm determinations documented
Ransom only with approvals and OFAC check; never decrypt the SCADA host
Vendor breach reports logged and handled
Annual tabletop with the MSP, integrator, and field staff
Lessons learned within 30 days
Three classification levels
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit; OT exceptions recorded
Restricted data only in approved systems; Geology folder limited to licensed users
List of where Restricted data is kept
New vendors and cloud features approved before receiving data or connecting to SCADA
Approved AI tools only; predictive maintenance add-on advisory only
Call-back before any bank detail change; monthly change report
Wipe or certified destruction with records
90-day immutable office backups; rotated offline SCADA backups; quarterly restore tests
Retention per schedule
